senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. b. h. חָתַל), to tie up, close, lock. Tanḥ.
units: <cite ref="Genesis 1:1">B’resh. 1</cite> <he>ח׳ את הים וכ׳</he> he locked the Ocean up, that it might not go forth &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:1:19">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>טבעת שׂחוֹתֵם בה</he> the ring with which he seals.

Ib. אסור לַחְתּוֹם בה you dare not use it for a seal; Tosef. ib. V (VI), 2; a. fr.—2) to sign, subscribe (as witness, judge &c.) Gitt. VI, 7 אחד … חוֹתְמִין one writes the document and two sign it as witnesses.
<cite ref="Gittin 66b:13">Ib. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ סופר</he> if the scribe signed as one of the witnesses.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 10:4">Shebi. X, 4</cite> <he>הדיינים חותמין וכ׳</he> the judges sign under it; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="H01876"><he>חָתוּם</he></cite>, f. <he>חֲתוּמָה</he>; pl. <he>חֲתוּמִים</he>, <he>חֲתוּמִין</he>; <he>חֲתוּמוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 25b">Yeb. 25ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>עדים הח׳ וכ׳</he> if witnesses are signed &c.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 10:6">Pes. X, 6</cite> <he>וחותם בגאולה</he> and he closes with redemption (Blessed be the Lord who redeemed Israel).
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 10:6">Ib.</cite> <he>לא היה חותם</he> he did not close with a benediction.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:4">Ber. I, 4</cite> <he>מקום שאמרו לַחְתּוֹם</he> where the Rabbis ordained to close a benediction with Barukh &c.; a. fr.—Part. pass. as ab.

<cite ref="Gittin 60a:7">Gitt. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>תורה ח׳ ניתנה</he> the Law was given as one complete book, opp. <he>מגילה מגילה</he> in single sheets. [<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:11">Cant. R. to I, 11</cite>, v. next w.]

senses.gloss: to provide with signatures. Y. Gitt. I, beg. 43ᵃ, a. e. מְחַתְּמוֹ בעדים וכ׳ he may have provided it with the signatures of unfit witnesses.
units: Ib. חִתְּמוֹ וכ׳.—Part. pass. מְחוּתָּם. Y. Keth. II, 26ᶜ; Y. Shebu. IV, 35ᶜ מח׳ בארבע וכ׳ provided with four signatures.
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 1:1">Gitt. I, 1</cite> <he>בפני נח׳</he> (Y. ed. <cite ref="H00613"><he>נתח׳</he></cite>) in my presence has it been signed; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be finally sentenced (by attaching the seal or signature).
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 16b:15">R. Hash. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>נכתבין ונֶחְתָּמִין וכ׳</he> their verdict is written and sealed at once; Y. ib. I, 57ᵃ <he>מִתְחַתְּמִין</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31">Gen. R. s. 31</cite>, beg. <he>נתח׳ גזר דינם</he> their decree was sealed; a. e.
